name: Outdoor Adjustable Canopy Swing 3 Person Grey
description: Add comfort to your outdoor space with this 3-seater Light Grey Swing Chair with Canopy. This garden swing is perfect for any balcony, patio or outdoor living space. Made from metal with a sling fabric seating, it has a UV-protected polyester canopy to keep you protected from rain and sunlight. Also, practically designed, it can match any outdoor decor setting in style.
